articles.title: Why Netanyahu's Vision Will Endure in Israel
articles.dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has dominated his country's politics for the last four decades, and his influence will not end even if Israelis vote him out of office. Over the course of his tenure as Israel's longest-serving prime minister, Netanyahu has dramatically reset the terms of the country's national security politics. His persistent rejection of Palestinian statehood has helped push the idea firmly out of mainstream debates, and his longtime agitation for war against Iran is now widely accepted policy across Israel's political and security establishment.

articles.dek: Silicon Valley moves fast and breaks things, but the U.S. electrical grid moves slowly and requires permits.
